interventions.label: White Decisive Win
interventions.text: Looking at the board, White is completely winning and has an overwhelming position. Key takeaway: White is up material with a decisive winning advantage and unstoppable attack against Black.

interventions.label: Dead Equal / Balanced
interventions.text: Looking at the board, the position is quiet, balanced, and equal. Key takeaway: Both sides have equal material, balanced piece activity, and no advantage for either side.

interventions.label: White Severe Deficit (Lost)
interventions.text: Looking at the board, White is completely lost with a severe material deficit. Key takeaway: White is down material with no counterplay, facing an overwhelming attack and lost game.
